summary: State permitting agencies (MassDEP, EFSB, MEPA and others) may not issue permits or authorizations for a data center project with peak demand over 25 MW unless the applicant has shown conformance with the June 25, 2026 state Framework and submitted a community benefits agreement reviewed by the Office of Environmental Justice and Equity.
notes: Third 25 MW state or utility threshold in the register, with Maryland EO (Sept 23) and Dominion GS-5.
text: shall not issue any permits or authorizations associated with any data center project with peak electricity demand exceeding twenty-five megawatts
